It was built for my Master's thesis, where I compared YOLOv5 and YOLOv10 for nodule detection. How it works 1. **Preprocessing** (`lung_nodule_detection/preprocess.py`) - Splits patients 70 / 20 / 10 into train, validation and test, so no patient appears in two splits. - Segments the lungs on every slice with the lungmask R231 model and skips slices without both lungs. - Crops each slice to the lungs, applies a CT window (centre -350 HU, width 1000 HU) and converts it to 8-bit. - Resizes every crop onto one canvas, the size of the largest lung crop in the data, keeping the aspect ratio. - Writes a YOLO label per slice: nodule boxes are enlarged by 30%,
